_meta.description: IronHell-derived monster dataset used by IronHell. Includes reference-identifying fields (serial, symbol, color, hp_dice, flags, blows, spells) plus wired IronHell runtime fields (id, type, dungeon_levels, ai_behavior, sprite, abilities, can_dig).

stats.hp: Current runtime HP baseline used by IronHell
stats.hp_dice: Original IronHell HP dice formula from I: line (XdY)
stats.attack_speed: IronHell combat cadence scalar (derived runtime field)
stats.movement_speed: IronHell movement speed baseline (I: speed, 100 = normal)

reference_fields.flags: IronHell RF1/RF2/RF3 booleans plus alertness where present
reference_fields.attacks: IronHell B: melee attack tuples (method, effect, dice_count, dice_sides)
reference_fields.abilities: IronHell monster abilities normalized to type/range/cooldown_ticks
reference_fields.spell_frequency: IronHell S: frequency divisor (lower = more frequent)

ironhell_wired_fields.id: Stable runtime key used in code
ironhell_wired_fields.ai_behavior: AI routing profile used by behavior systems

notes: Dataset has full serial parity with reference range.

constraints: Some fields are IronHell-specific runtime extensions and should be mapped or ignored in other engines.
attack_speed is an engine-specific scalar and may not map 1:1 to other combat loops.
recommended_consumption: Treat serial as canonical cross-reference key to IronHell sources.
Use hp_dice when reproducing strict IronHell HP generation; use hp for existing IronHell runtime balance.
If building a neutral dataset, split into reference core + engine extension layer.
future_migration_notes: Future AI integrations should treat stats.hp_dice as the canonical HP source for IronHell-faithful behavior.
stats.hp should be considered a compatibility baseline for existing IronHell runtime behavior until hp_dice-driven spawning is adopted.

monsters.name: Quylthulg
monsters.description: It is a strange pulsing mound of flesh.

monsters.name: Sasquatch
monsters.description: A tall shaggy, furry humanoid, it could call the yeti brother.

monsters.name: Werewolf
monsters.description: A man-wolf that moves with unnatural speed, hackles raised.

monsters.name: Dark Elven Lord
monsters.description: A powerful dark elf noble sleeping in a luxurious underground chamber.

monsters.name: Cloud giant
monsters.description: It is a twenty foot tall giant wreathed in clouds.

monsters.name: Lugdush, the Uruk
monsters.description: A large and powerful orc, captain of one of Saruman's orcish regiments.

monsters.name: Ugluk, the Uruk
monsters.description: A strong and cunning orc warrior, the commander of Saruman's orcish horde.

monsters.name: Blue dragon bat
monsters.description: It is a glowing blue bat with a sharp tail.

monsters.name: Scroll mimic
monsters.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as a discarded scroll to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Fire vortex
monsters.description: A whirling maelstrom of fire.

monsters.name: Water vortex
monsters.description: A caustic spinning whirlpool of water.

monsters.name: Cold vortex
monsters.description: A twisting whirlpool of frost.

monsters.name: Energy vortex
monsters.description: A shimmering tornado of air, sparks crackle along its length.

monsters.name: Mummified orc
monsters.description: It is an orcish figure covered in wrappings.

monsters.name: Killer stag beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle with vicious claws.

monsters.name: Iron golem
monsters.description: It is a massive metal statue that moves steadily towards you.

monsters.name: Giant yellow scorpion
monsters.description: It is a giant scorpion with a sharp stinger.

monsters.name: Black ooze
monsters.description: It is a strangely moving puddle.

monsters.name: Hardened warrior
monsters.description: A scarred warrior who moves with confidence.

monsters.name: Azog, King of the Uruk-Hai
monsters.description: He is also known as the King of Khazad-dum. His ego is renowned to be bigger than his head.

monsters.name: Master rogue
monsters.description: A thief of great power and shifty speed.

monsters.name: Red dragon bat
monsters.description: It is a sharp-tailed bat, wreathed in fire.

monsters.name: Killer white beetle
monsters.description: It is looking for prey.

monsters.name: Giant bronze dragon fly
monsters.description: This vast gleaming bronze fly has wings which beat mesmerically fast.

monsters.name: Forest Wight
monsters.description: A wight that haunts the wooded barrows, draining life with a touch.

monsters.name: Ibun, Son of Mim
monsters.description: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Ibun is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.

monsters.name: Khim, Son of Mim
monsters.description: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Khim is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.

monsters.name: 4-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian hybrid with four heads, guarding its hoard.

monsters.name: Mummified human
monsters.description: It is a human form encased in mouldy wrappings.

monsters.name: Vampire bat
monsters.description: A blood-sucking bat that flies at your neck hungrily.

monsters.name: Sangahyando of Umbar
monsters.description: A Black Numenorean with a blacker heart.

monsters.name: Angamaite of Umbar
monsters.description: A Black Numenorean who hates the men of the west.

monsters.name: Banshee
monsters.description: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.

monsters.name: Pukelman
monsters.description: A stumpy figure carved from stone, with glittering eyes, this sentinel strides towards you with deadly intent.

monsters.name: Dark elven druid
monsters.description: A powerful dark elf, with mighty nature-controlling enchantments.

monsters.name: Stone troll
monsters.description: He is a giant troll with scabrous black skin.

monsters.name: Troll priest
monsters.description: A troll who is so bright he knows how to read.

monsters.name: Wereworm
monsters.description: A huge wormlike shape dripping acid, twisted by evil sorcery into a foul monster that breeds on death.

monsters.name: Carrion crawler
monsters.description: A hideous centipede covered in slime and with glowing tentacles around its head.

monsters.name: Killer red beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle with poisonous mandibles.

monsters.name: Giant grey ant
monsters.description: It is an ant encased in shaggy grey fur.

monsters.name: Ulwarth, Son of Ulfang
monsters.description: A short and swarthy Easterling.

monsters.name: Displacer beast
monsters.description: It is a huge black panther, clubbed tentacles sprouting from its shoulders.

monsters.name: Giant fire tick
monsters.description: It is smoking and burning with great heat.

monsters.name: Cave ogre
monsters.description: A giant orc-like figure with an awesomely muscled frame.

monsters.name: White Wraith
monsters.description: A ghostly white form that drains experience from those it touches.

monsters.name: Angel
monsters.description: Who knows why you are now facing an angel as an enemy? Is it a punishment from your own god for your sins, or a test of your mettle, or has this angel been sent by another god on behalf of someone who wishes to claim the glory for his own god? Perhaps you will never know: but it is here, and you must fight it.

monsters.name: Mim, Betrayer of Turin
monsters.description: The last of his race, Mim is a Petty-Dwarf. Petty-Dwarves are strange creatures, powerful in sorcery and originating in the East. They have been hunted nearly to extinction by the High Elves.

monsters.name: Killer fire beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle wreathed in flames.

monsters.name: Creeping adamantite coins
monsters.description: It appears to be a pile of coins made of precious adamant, slithering toward you on lots of tiny legs.

monsters.name: Algroth
monsters.description: A powerful troll form. Venom drips from its needlelike claws.

monsters.name: Vibration hound
monsters.description: A blurry canine form which seems to be moving as fast as the eye can follow. You can feel the earth resonating beneath your feet.

monsters.name: Nexus hound
monsters.description: A locus of conflicting points coalesce to form the vague shape of a huge hound. Or is it just your imagination?

monsters.name: Ogre Mage
monsters.description: A hideous ogre wrapped in black sorcerous robes who rests between bouts of dark study.

monsters.name: Lokkak, the Ogre Chieftain
monsters.description: An ogre renowned for acts of surpassing cruelty, Lokkak quickly became the leader of a large band of violent ogres.

monsters.name: Vampire
monsters.description: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.

monsters.name: Gorgimaera
monsters.description: The result of evil experiments, this travesty of nature should never be alive. It has three heads - goat, dragon and gorgon - all attached to a lion's body.

monsters.name: Colbran
monsters.description: A man-shaped form of living lightning, sparks and shocks crackle all over this madly capering figure, as it leaps and whirls around and about you.

monsters.name: Spirit naga
monsters.description: A wraithly snake-like form with the torso of a beautiful woman, it is the most powerful of its kind.

monsters.name: 5-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian hybrid with five heads dripping venom.

monsters.name: Black knight
monsters.description: He is a figure encased in deep black plate armor.

monsters.name: Uldor the Accursed
monsters.description: An evil and cunning man from the East. Having once sworn allegiance to the sons of Feanor, it was Uldor's treachery that turned the tide of the Battle of Unnumbered Tears in Morgoth's favour.

monsters.name: Mage
monsters.description: A mage of some power - you can tell by the size of his hat.

monsters.name: Mind flayer
monsters.description: A humanoid with a gruesome head, tentacular mouth, and piercing eyes.

monsters.name: Draebor, the Imp
monsters.description: An intensely irritating git of a monster.

monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.description: An evil reptile that preys on unsuspecting travellers. Its eyes stare deeply at you and your soul starts to wilt!

monsters.name: Ice troll
monsters.description: He is a white troll with powerfully clawed hands.

monsters.name: Purple Worm
monsters.description: A massive worm form many feet in length whose vast maw drips with acid.

monsters.name: Archangel
monsters.description: An angel protected by an aura of holiness. Its muscular form looks extremely powerful next to your own frail body.

monsters.name: Catoblepas
monsters.description: A strange ox-like form with a huge head but a thin, weak neck, it looks likes the creation of some deranged alchemist.

monsters.name: Ring mimic
monsters.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as a discarded ring to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

monsters.name: Young Blue Dragon
monsters.description: A young electric dragon sleeping coiled in its lair.

monsters.name: Young White Dragon
monsters.description: A young frost dragon curled in icy slumber.

monsters.name: Young Green Dragon
monsters.description: A young poison dragon drowsing in a cloud of noxious fumes.

monsters.name: Young bronze dragon
monsters.description: It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a rich bronze hue, and its shape glitters with strange colours that confuse you.

monsters.name: Mithril golem
monsters.description: It is a massive statue of purest mithril. It looks expensive!

monsters.name: Shadow Drake
monsters.description: A dragon-like form wrapped in shadow with glowing red eyes, surrounded by an aura of deathly cold.

monsters.name: Skeleton troll
monsters.description: It is a troll skeleton animated by dark dweomers.

monsters.name: Manticore
monsters.description: It is a winged lion's body with a human torso and a tail covered in vicious spikes.

monsters.name: Giant blue ant
monsters.description: It is a giant ant that crackles with energy.

monsters.name: Giant army ant
monsters.description: An armored form moving with purpose. Powerful on its own, flee when hordes of them march.

monsters.name: Grave Wight
monsters.description: A wight that has risen from a grave, lying still as death until disturbed.

monsters.name: Killer slicer beetle
monsters.description: It is a beetle with deadly sharp cutting mandibles and a rock-hard carapace.

monsters.name: Ghost
monsters.description: You do not believe in it, but it believes in you... An invisible undead spirit that drains your very mind.

monsters.name: Death watch beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle that produces a chilling sound.

monsters.name: Ogre shaman
monsters.description: It is an ogre wrapped in furs and covered in grotesque body paints.

monsters.name: Nexus quylthulg
monsters.description: It is a very unstable, strange pulsing mound of flesh.

monsters.name: Shelob, Spider of Darkness
monsters.description: Shelob is an enormous bloated spider, the last daughter of Ungoliant the Unlight. Her poison is legendary, as is her ego. She normally guards the pass through Cirith Ungol, but occasionally goes out foraging for food to feed her voracious appetite.

monsters.name: Ninja
monsters.description: A humanoid clothed in black who moves with blinding speed.

monsters.name: Memory moss
monsters.description: A mass of green vegetation. You don't remember seeing anything like it before.

monsters.name: Storm giant
monsters.description: It is a twenty-five foot tall giant wreathed in lightning.

monsters.name: Cave Troll
monsters.description: Huge and dimwitted, but terrifying in close quarters.

monsters.name: Half-troll
monsters.description: A huge, ugly, half-human in search of plunder.

monsters.name: Mystic
monsters.description: An adept at unarmed combat, the mystic strikes with stunning power. He can summon help from nature and is able to focus his power to ease any pain.

monsters.name: Barrow Wight
monsters.description: An ancient wight resting in its burial mound, waiting to drain the unwary.

monsters.name: Skeleton ettin
monsters.description: It is the animated form of a massive two-headed troll.

monsters.name: Chaos drake
monsters.description: A dragon twisted by the forces of chaos. It seems first ugly, then fair, as its form shimmers and changes in front of your eyes.

monsters.name: Law drake
monsters.description: This dragon is clever and cunning. It laughs at your puny efforts to disturb it.

monsters.name: Balance drake
monsters.description: A mighty dragon, the balance drake seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance, and despises your feeble efforts to destroy evil.

monsters.name: Ethereal drake
monsters.description: A dragon of great power, with control over light and dark, the ethereal drake's eyes glare with white hatred from the shadows.

monsters.name: Bert the Stone Troll
monsters.description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bill and Tom.

monsters.name: Bill the Stone Troll
monsters.description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bert and Tom.

monsters.name: Tom the Stone Troll
monsters.description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bert and Bill.

monsters.name: Shade
monsters.description: A shadowy form clutches at you from the darkness. A powerful undead creature with a deadly touch.

monsters.name: Spectre
monsters.description: A phantasmal shrieking spirit that passes through walls to drain life and mind.

monsters.name: Water troll
monsters.description: He is a troll that reeks of brine.

monsters.name: Fire Elemental
monsters.description: A roiling mass of living flame given rudimentary will.

monsters.name: Cherub
monsters.description: It is an angel moving very quickly, wielding a holy war hammer and casting a volley of powerful spells in your direction.

monsters.name: Water elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering tempest of water.

monsters.name: Invisible stalker
monsters.description: It is impossible to define its form but its violence is legendary.

monsters.name: Carrion crawler
monsters.description: A hideous centipede covered in slime and with glowing tentacles around its head.

monsters.name: Master thief
monsters.description: Cool and confident, fast and lithe; protect your possessions quickly!

monsters.name: Ulfang the Black
monsters.description: A short and swarthy Easterling dressed in black. He and his three sons once openly swore allegiance to the High Elves, but were secretly in the pay of Morgoth.

monsters.name: Lich
monsters.description: A dread undead sorcerer sealed in skeletal form by dark pacts. It rests between workings of terrible magic.

monsters.name: Master Vampire
monsters.description: A humanoid figure dressed in robes, sleeping in its coffin. Power emanates from its chilling frame.

monsters.name: Giant grey scorpion
monsters.description: It is a giant grey scorpion. It looks poisonous.

monsters.name: Earth elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering form composed of rock with fists of awesome power.

monsters.name: Air elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering tornado of winds.

monsters.name: Hellhound
monsters.description: It is a giant dog that glows with heat. Flames pour from its nostrils.

monsters.name: Eog golem
monsters.description: It is a massive deep brown statue, striding towards you with an all-too-familiar purpose. Your magic surprisingly feels much less powerful now.

monsters.name: Olog
monsters.description: It is a massive intelligent troll with needle-sharp fangs.

monsters.name: Dagashi
monsters.description: A human warrior, moving with lightning speed.

monsters.name: Gravity hound
monsters.description: Unfettered by the usual constraints of gravity, these unnatural creatures are walking on the walls and even the ceiling! The earth suddenly feels rather less solid as you see gravity warp all round the monsters.

monsters.name: Acidic cytoplasm
monsters.description: A disgusting animated blob of destruction. Flee its gruesome hunger!

monsters.name: Inertia hound
monsters.description: Bizarrely, this hound seems to be hardly moving at all, yet it approaches you with deadly menace. It makes you tired just to look at it.

monsters.name: Impact hound
monsters.description: A deep brown shape is visible before you, its canine form strikes you with an almost physical force. The dungeon floor buckles as if struck by a powerful blow as it stalks towards you.

monsters.name: Dread
monsters.description: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself struggles to banish it.

monsters.name: Ooze elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering mass of filth, an eyesore of ooze.

monsters.name: Smoke elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering blackened form, crackling with heat.

monsters.name: Young Black Dragon
monsters.description: A young acid dragon sleeping among the corroded bones of its prey.

monsters.name: Mumak
monsters.description: A massive elephantine form with eyes twisted by madness.

monsters.name: Giant fire ant
monsters.description: A giant ant covered in shaggy fur. Its powerful jaws glow with heat.

monsters.name: Mature White Dragon
monsters.description: A large frost dragon covered in rimed scales, slumbering in a frozen cavern.

monsters.name: Xorn
monsters.description: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.

monsters.name: Shadow
monsters.description: A mighty spirit of darkness of vaguely humanoid form. Razor-edged claws reach out to end your life as it glides towards you, seeking to suck the energy from your soul to feed its power.

monsters.name: Phantom
monsters.description: An unholy creature of darkness, the aura emanating from this evil being saps your very soul.

monsters.name: Grey Wraith
monsters.description: A tangible but ghostly form made of grey fog. The air around it feels deathly cold.

monsters.name: Young multi-hued dragon
monsters.description: It has a form that legends are made of. Beautiful scales of shimmering and magical colours cover it.

monsters.name: Colossus
monsters.description: An enormous construct resembling a titan made from stone. It strides purposefully towards you, swinging its slow fists with earth-shattering power.

monsters.name: Young gold dragon
monsters.description: It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a tarnished gold hue, and light is reflected from its form.

monsters.name: Rogrog the Black Troll
monsters.description: A massive and cruel troll of great power, drool slides caustically down his muscular frame. Despite his bulk, he strikes with stunning speed.

monsters.name: Mature Blue Dragon
monsters.description: A large blue dragon bristling with static charge, sleeping deeply in its lair.

monsters.name: Mature Green Dragon
monsters.description: A large green dragon wreathed in toxic vapour, resting deep below.

monsters.name: Mature bronze dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon with scales of rich bronze.

monsters.name: Young Red Dragon
monsters.description: Not yet ancient, but already a catastrophe on wings.

monsters.name: Trapper
monsters.description: A larger cousin of the lurker, this creature traps unsuspecting victims and paralyzes them, to be slowly digested later.

monsters.name: Bodak
monsters.description: It is a humanoid form composed of flames and hatred.

monsters.name: Ice elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering glacier of ice.

monsters.name: Necromancer
monsters.description: A gaunt figure, clothed in black robes.

monsters.name: Lorgan, Chief of the Easterlings
monsters.description: A mighty warrior from the east, Lorgan hates everything that he cannot control.

monsters.name: Demonologist
monsters.description: A figure twisted by evil standing in robes of deepest crimson.

monsters.name: Mummified troll
monsters.description: It is a massive figure clothed in wrappings. You are wary of its massive fists.

monsters.name: The Queen Ant
monsters.description: She's upset because you hurt her children.

monsters.name: Will o' the wisp
monsters.description: A strange ball of glowing light. It disappears and reappears and seems to draw you to it. You seem somehow compelled to stand still and watch its strange dancing motion.

monsters.name: Magma elemental
monsters.description: It is a towering glowing form of molten hate.

monsters.name: Black pudding
monsters.description: A lump of rotting black flesh that slurrrrrrrps across the dungeon floor.

monsters.name: Killer iridescent beetle
monsters.description: It is a giant beetle, whose carapace shimmers with vibrant energies.

monsters.name: Nexus vortex
monsters.description: A maelstrom of potent magical energy.

monsters.name: Plasma vortex
monsters.description: A whirlpool of intense flame, charring the stones at your feet.

monsters.name: Mature Red Dragon
monsters.description: A large red dragon deep in fiery slumber, scales glowing with inner heat.

monsters.name: Mature gold dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon with scales of gleaming gold.

monsters.name: Crystal drake
monsters.description: A dragon of strange crystalline form. Light shines through it, dazzling your eyes with spectrums of colour.

monsters.name: Mature Black Dragon
monsters.description: A large black dragon sleeping amid pools of acid that corrode everything around it.

monsters.name: Mature multi-hued dragon
monsters.description: A large dragon, scales shimmering many colours.

monsters.name: Death Knight
monsters.description: A humanoid figure in armor of ancient form. From beneath its helmet, eyes glow a baleful red that pierce like lances of fire.

monsters.name: Castamir the Usurper
monsters.description: A Black Numenorean who usurped the throne of Gondor, he is treacherous and evil.

monsters.name: Time vortex
monsters.description: You haven't seen it yet.

monsters.name: Shimmering vortex
monsters.description: A strange pillar of shining light that hurts your eyes. Its shape changes constantly as it cuts through the air towards you. It is like a beacon, waking monsters from their slumber.

monsters.name: Ancient Blue Dragon
monsters.description: A massive ancient dragon, scales blazing with stored electricity, sleeping with one eye barely closed.

monsters.name: Ancient bronze dragon
monsters.description: A huge draconic form enveloped in a cascade of colour.

monsters.name: Beholder
monsters.description: A vile creature with one huge central eye, twelve smaller eyes on stalks, and a huge mouth filled with sharp teeth.

monsters.name: Emperor Wight
monsters.description: Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches from its ancient throne room.

monsters.name: Seraph
monsters.description: It is an angel, fast and strong. You are stunned by its extreme holiness and try to resist all desires to obey it.

monsters.name: Vargo, Tyrant of Fire
monsters.description: A towering fire elemental, Vargo burns everything beyond recognition.

monsters.name: Black Wraith
monsters.description: A wraith of pure shadow and malice that drains the life force from those it touches.

monsters.name: Erinyes
monsters.description: It is a lesser demon of female form; however, she takes little time to show her true colours.

monsters.name: Nether wraith
monsters.description: A form that hurts the eye, death permeates the air around it. As it nears you, a coldness saps your soul.

monsters.name: Eldrak
monsters.description: A massive troll, larger and stronger than many men together.

monsters.name: Ettin
monsters.description: A massive two-headed troll of huge strength, ettins are stupid but violent. They are also living proof that two heads are not more intelligent than one...

monsters.name: Waldern, King of Water
monsters.description: A towering water elemental, Waldern is master of all things liquid. Wave after wave drowns your frail body.

monsters.name: Kavlax the Many-Headed
monsters.description: A large dragon with a selection of heads, all shouting and arguing as they look for prey, but each with its own deadly breath weapon.

monsters.name: Ancient White Dragon
monsters.description: An ancient frost dragon encrusted with centuries of ice, dreaming cold dreams.

monsters.name: Ancient Green Dragon
monsters.description: An ancient green dragon enveloped in a permanent cloud of lethal vapour.

monsters.name: 7-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian hybrid with seven heads dripping venom.

monsters.name: Night mare
monsters.description: A fearsome skeletal horse with glowing eyes, that watch you with little more than a hatred of all that lives.

monsters.name: Vampire Lord
monsters.description: An ancient noble of the undead who commands lesser vampires.

monsters.name: Ancient Black Dragon
monsters.description: An ancient black dragon resting in a lake of dissolved stone. Its mere breath corrodes iron.

monsters.name: Disenchanter worm mass
monsters.description: It is a strange mass of squirming worms. Magical energy crackles around its disgusting form.

monsters.name: Rotting quylthulg
monsters.description: It is a pulsing flesh mound that reeks of death and putrefaction.

monsters.name: Spirit troll
monsters.description: A weird ghostly troll-like being from the ethereal plane.

monsters.name: Lesser titan
monsters.description: It is a humanoid figure thirty feet tall that gives off an aura of power and hate.

monsters.name: 9-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian hybrid with nine smouldering heads.

monsters.name: Enchantress
monsters.description: This elusive female spellcaster has a special affinity for dragons, whom she rarely fights without.

monsters.name: Knight Templar
monsters.description: It seems that the more devout the person, the more likely they are to cross the boundary between piety and sanctimoniousness. And such is the case with the Order of the Knights Templar; they are among the most pious and powerful of the religious knightly orders, but noted for their intolerance. Thus it is Morgoth's will that is unwittingly done, as the forces of good are set against each other.

monsters.name: Sorcerer
monsters.description: A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his hands are ablur with spell casting.

monsters.name: Xaren
monsters.description: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.

monsters.name: Giant roc
monsters.description: A vast legendary bird, its iron talons rake the most impenetrable of surfaces and its screech echoes through the many winding dungeon corridors.

monsters.name: Uvatha the Horseman
monsters.description: A tall black cloaked Ringwraith, he is a master of horsemanship. He longs to taste your blood.

monsters.name: Minotaur
monsters.description: It is a cross between a human and a bull.

monsters.name: Medusa, the Gorgon
monsters.description: One of the original three ugly sisters. Her face could sink a thousand ships. Her scales rattle as she slithers towards you, venom dripping from her ghastly mouth.

monsters.name: Death drake
monsters.description: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in darkness. You cannot make out its true form but you sense its evil.

monsters.name: Ancient Red Dragon
monsters.description: An elder tyrant of flame, hoard-king of the abyssal halls.

monsters.name: Ancient gold dragon
monsters.description: A huge draconic form wreathed in a nimbus of light. Its roar stuns and deafens you.

monsters.name: Great crystal drake
monsters.description: A huge crystalline dragon. Its claws could cut you to shreds and its teeth are razor sharp. Strange colours ripple through it as it moves in the light.

monsters.name: Vrock
monsters.description: It is a demon with a long neck and raking claws.

monsters.name: Death quasit
monsters.description: It is a demon of small stature, but its armored frame moves with lightning speed and its powers make it a tornado of death and destruction.

monsters.name: Adunaphel the Quiet
monsters.description: A sorceress in life, Adunaphel quickly fell under Sauron's sway and the power of the rings.

monsters.name: Dark elven sorcerer
monsters.description: A dark elven figure, dressed in deepest black. Power seems to crackle from his slender frame.

monsters.name: Master lich
monsters.description: A skeletal form wrapped in robes. Powerful magic crackles along its bony fingers.

monsters.name: Hezrou
monsters.description: It is a demon of lizard form with cruel-looking jaws.

monsters.name: Akhorahil the Blind
monsters.description: A mighty sorcerer King, Akhorahil was blind in life. With powerful enchantments, he created jewelled eyes that enabled him to see better than any ordinary man ever could.

monsters.name: Gorlim, Betrayer of Barahir
monsters.description: This sad creature - once a mighty warrior - betrayed his former friends to Morgoth's army in return for, he thought, safety for himself and his wife. And so he fell under Morgoth's power and became little more than a mindless servant of evil, even though the other side of his "bargain" was not kept.

monsters.name: Archon
monsters.description: Never a more heavenly being have you seen. The very holiness of its presence makes you deeply respect it. Few creatures can match the powers of an Archon; fewer still live to tell the tale after attacking one.

monsters.name: Glabrezu
monsters.description: It is demon with arms and pincers, its form a true mockery of life.

monsters.name: Ren the Unclean
monsters.description: Ren was an insane eastern king who believed himself to be the son of a volcano god. At an early age his sanity was destroyed by a plague that wiped out his family, and he never recovered.

monsters.name: Nalfeshnee
monsters.description: It is a large demon with the head of a giant boar. Flames run up and down its length.

monsters.name: Undead beholder
monsters.description: A beholder which has cheated death. Black nether storms rage around the bloodshot pupil of its central giant eye, and light seems to bend as it sucks its power from the very air around it. Your soul chills as it drains your vitality for its evil enchantments.

monsters.name: Dread
monsters.description: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself struggles to banish it.

monsters.name: Mumak
monsters.description: A massive elephantine form with eyes twisted by madness.

monsters.name: Ancient multi-hued dragon
monsters.description: A huge draconic form. Many colours ripple down its massive frame.

monsters.name: Ethereal dragon
monsters.description: A huge dragon emanating from the ethereal plane, this terrible dragon is a master of light and dark. Its form disappears from sight as it cloaks itself in unearthly shadows.

monsters.name: Ji Indur Dawndeath
monsters.description: This Ringwraith was a weak-minded sorcerer-king who fell easily under Sauron's power.

monsters.name: Marilith
monsters.description: She is a demon of female form with many arms, each bearing deadly weapons.

monsters.name: Quaker, Master of Earth
monsters.description: A towering stone elemental stands before you. The walls and ceiling are reduced to rubble as Quaker advances.

monsters.name: Lesser Balrog
monsters.description: It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in flames.

monsters.name: Ariel, Queen of Air
monsters.description: A towering air elemental, Ariel, the sorceress, avoids your blows with her extreme speed.

monsters.name: 11-headed hydra
monsters.description: A strange reptilian hybrid with eleven smouldering heads.

monsters.name: Patriarch
monsters.description: An evil priest, dressed all in black. Deadly spells hit you at an alarming rate as his black spiked mace rains down blow after blow on your pitiful frame.

monsters.name: Dreadmaster
monsters.description: It is an unlife of power almost unequaled. An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crush rock and flesh with ease.

monsters.name: Drolem
monsters.description: A constructed dragon, the drolem has massive strength. Powerful spells weaved during its creation make it a fearsome adversary. Its eyes show little intelligence, but it has been instructed to destroy all it meets.

monsters.name: Scatha the Worm
monsters.description: An ancient and wise Dragon. Scatha has grown clever over the long years. His scales are covered with frost, and his breath sends a shower of ice into the air.

monsters.name: Dwar, Dog Lord of Waw
monsters.description: Dwar had a special affinity for dogs in life, and can still command them at will. He howls maniacally as he reaches out to destroy you.

monsters.name: Smaug the Golden
monsters.description: Smaug is one of the Uruloki that still survive, a fire-drake of immense cunning.

monsters.name: Dracolich
monsters.description: The skeletal form of a once-great dragon, enchanted by magic most perilous. Its animated form strikes with speed and drains life from its prey to satisfy its hunger.

monsters.name: Greater titan
monsters.description: A forty foot tall humanoid that shakes the ground as it walks. The power radiating from its frame shakes your courage, its hatred inspired by your defiance.

monsters.name: Dracolisk
monsters.description: A mixture of dragon and basilisk, the dracolisk stares at you with deep piercing eyes, its evil breath burning the ground where it stands.

monsters.name: Death mold
monsters.description: It is the epitome of all that is evil, in a mold. Its lifeless form draws power from sucking the souls of those that approach it, a nimbus of pure evil surrounds it. Luckily for you, it can't move.

monsters.name: Itangast the Fire Drake
monsters.description: A mighty ancient dragon, Itangast's form scorches your flesh. Wisps of smoke curl up from his nostrils as he regards you with disdain.

monsters.name: Glaurung, Father of the Dragons
monsters.description: Glaurung is the father of all dragons, and was for a long time the most powerful. Though this is no longer so, he still has full command over his brood and can command them to appear whenever he so wishes. He is the definition of dragonfire.

monsters.name: Master mystic
monsters.description: A lord of all that is natural, skilled in the mystic ways. He is a master of martial arts and is at one with nature, able to summon help from the wild if need be.

monsters.name: The Balrog of Moria
monsters.description: A huge Balrog surrounded by raging pillars of fire. Wielding a great whip of fire and a blazing sword.

monsters.name: Nightwing
monsters.description: Everywhere colours seem paler and the air chiller. At the centre of the cold stands a mighty figure. Its wings envelop you in the chill of death as the nightwing reaches out to draw you into oblivion. Your muscles sag and your mind loses all will to fight as you stand in awe of this mighty being.

monsters.name: Nether hound
monsters.description: You feel a soul-tearing chill upon viewing this beast, a ghostly form of darkness in the shape of a large dog.

monsters.name: Time hound
monsters.description: You get a terrible sense of deja vu, or is it a premonition? All at once you see a little puppy and a toothless old dog. Perhaps you should give up and go to bed.

monsters.name: Plasma hound
monsters.description: The very air warps as pure elemental energy stalks towards you in the shape of a giant hound. Your hair stands on end and your palms itch as you sense trouble.

monsters.name: Demonic quylthulg
monsters.description: A pile of pulsing flesh that glows with an inner hellish fire. The world itself seems to cry out against it.

monsters.name: Great Storm Wyrm
monsters.description: A vast dragon of power. Storms and lightning crash around its titanic form. Deep blue scales reflect the flashes and highlight the creature's great muscles. It regards you with contempt.

monsters.name: Baphomet the Minotaur Lord
monsters.description: A fearsome bull-headed monster, Baphomet swings a mighty axe as he curses all that defy him.

monsters.name: Harowen the Black Hand
monsters.description: He is a master of disguise, an expert of stealth, a genius at traps, and moves with blinding speed. Check your pockets!

monsters.name: Hoarmurath of Dir
monsters.description: A Ringwraith powerful in fell sorcery, he yearns for the life he has lost for an unlife of everlasting torment.

monsters.name: Grand master mystic
monsters.description: He is one of the few true masters of the art, being extremely skillful in all forms of unarmed combat and controlling the world's natural creatures with disdainful ease.

monsters.name: Khamul, the Black Easterling
monsters.description: A warrior-king of the East. Khamul is a powerful opponent, his skill in combat awesome and his form twisted by evil cunning.

monsters.name: Ethereal hound
monsters.description: A pale green hound. Pulsing red lines and strange fluorescent light hints at internal organs best left to the imagination.

monsters.name: Great Ice Wyrm
monsters.description: An immense dragon capable of awesome destruction. You have never felt such extreme cold, or witnessed such an icy stare. Begone quickly or feel its wrath!

monsters.name: The Phoenix
monsters.description: A massive glowing eagle bathed in flames. The searing heat chars your skin and melts your armor.

monsters.name: Nightcrawler
monsters.description: This intensely evil creature bears the form of a gargantuan black worm. Its gaping maw is a void of blackness, acid drips from its steely hide. It is like nothing you have ever seen before, and a terrible chill runs down your spine as you face it.

monsters.name: Hand druj
monsters.description: A skeletal hand floating in the air, motionless except for its flexing fingers.

monsters.name: Eye druj
monsters.description: A bloodshot eyeball floating in the air, you'd be forgiven for assuming it harmless.

monsters.name: Skull druj
monsters.description: A glowing skull possessed by sorcerous power. It need not move, but merely blast you with mighty magic as it speaks the words of power.

monsters.name: Chaos vortex
monsters.description: Void, nothingness, spinning destructively.

monsters.name: Aether vortex
monsters.description: An awesome vortex of pure magic, power radiates from its frame.

monsters.name: The Lernaean Hydra
monsters.description: A massive legendary hydra. It has twelve powerful heads. Its many eyes stare at you as clouds of smoke and poisonous vapour rise from its seething form. And it grows new heads as fast as you chop them off.

monsters.name: Thuringwethil, the Vampire Messenger
monsters.description: Chief messenger between Sauron and Morgoth, she is surely the most deadly of her vampire race. At first she is charming to meet, but her wings and eyes give away her true form.

monsters.name: Great Hell Wyrm
monsters.description: A vast dragon of immense power. Fire leaps continuously from its huge form. The air around it scalds you. Its slightest glance burns you, and you truly realize how insignificant you are.

monsters.name: Draconic quylthulg
monsters.description: It looks like it was once a dragon corpse, now deeply infected with magical bacteria that make it pulse in a foul and degrading way.

monsters.name: Fundin Bluecloak
monsters.description: He is one of the greatest dwarven priests to walk the earth. Fundin has earned a high position in the church, and his skill with both weapon and spell only justify his position further. His combination of both dwarven strength and priestly wisdom are a true match for any adventurer.

monsters.name: Uriel, Angel of Fire
monsters.description: A creature of godly appearance, you dare not challenge Uriel's supremacy. Those who stood against him before are but a memory, cremated by his mastery of elemental fire.

monsters.name: Azriel, Angel of Death
monsters.description: Azriel commands awesome power, his visage holy enough to shrivel your soul. You shriek with disbelief as his mastery of death draws you to your grave. It is truly beyond all but the mightiest of warriors to stand against him and live.

monsters.name: Ancalagon the Black
monsters.description: "Rushing Jaws" is his name, and death is his game; the greatest and most terrible of all dragonkind, his power dismayed even the Valar for a time.

monsters.name: Nightwalker
monsters.description: A huge giant garbed in black, more massive than a titan and stronger than a dragon. With terrible blows, it breaks your armor from your back, leaving you defenseless against its evil wrath. It can smell your fear, and you in turn smell the awful stench of death as this ghastly figure strides towards you menacingly.

monsters.name: Gabriel, the Messenger
monsters.description: Commanding a legion of angels, Gabriel will destroy you for your sins. He will crush you like the pitiful insignificant being he sees you to be. Your very soul will be taken into judgement by his supreme authority as he cleanses the world of evil.

monsters.name: Saruman of Many Colours
monsters.description: Originally known as the White, Saruman fell prey to Sauron's wiles. He seeks to emulate him and breeds orcs and trolls to fight for him. He searches forever for the One Ring, to become a mighty Sorcerer-King of the world.

monsters.name: Dreadlord
monsters.description: It is a massive form of animated death, its colour deeper than black. It drinks in light, and space around it is twisted and torn by the weight of its evil. It is unlife and it knows nothing but the stealing of souls and the stench of death. Flee its hunger!

monsters.name: The Cat Lord
monsters.description: Master of all things feline, the Cat Lord moves with unsurpassed stealth.

monsters.name: Jabberwock
monsters.description: "Beware the Jabberwock, my son! The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!" Run and run quickly, for death incarnate chases behind you!

monsters.name: Chaos hound
monsters.description: A constantly changing canine form, this hound rushes towards you as if expecting mayhem and chaos ahead. It appears to have an almost kamikaze relish for combat. You suspect all may not be as it seems.

monsters.name: Great Wyrm of Chaos
monsters.description: An ancient terror whose breath warps flesh, steel, and fate.

monsters.name: Great Wyrm of Law
monsters.description: A massive dragon of powerful intellect. It seeks to dominate the universe and despises all other life. It sees all who do not obey it as mere insects to be crushed underfoot.

monsters.name: Great Wyrm of Balance
monsters.description: A massive dragon, one of the mightiest of dragonkind. It is thousands of years old and seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance. It sees you as an upstart troublemaker without the wisdom to control your actions. It will destroy you.

monsters.name: Tselakus, the Dreadlord
monsters.description: This huge affront to existence twists and tears at the fabric of space. A master of mighty magic, Tselakus hungers for your tender flesh. Darkness itself recoils from the touch of Tselakus as he leaves a trail of death and destruction. Tselakus is a being of sneering contempt, laughing at your pitiful efforts to defy him. Mighty claws rend reality as he annihilates all in his path to your soul!

monsters.name: Great Wyrm of Many Colours
monsters.description: A gigantic dragon whose scales shimmer in myriad hues.

monsters.name: Black reaver
monsters.description: A humanoid form, black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably, even the very rock of the dungeon cannot prevent it reaching you.

monsters.name: Greater demonic quylthulg
monsters.description: A massive pulsating mound of flesh, glowing with a hellish light.

monsters.name: Greater draconic quylthulg
monsters.description: A massive mound of scaled flesh, throbbing and pulsating with multi-hued light.

monsters.name: Greater rotting quylthulg
monsters.description: A massive pile of rotting flesh. A disgusting stench fills the air as it throbs and writhes.

monsters.name: Feagwath, the Undead Sorcerer
monsters.description: A stench of corruption and decay surrounds this sorcerer, who has clearly risen from the dead to continue his foul plots and schemes.

monsters.name: Omarax, the Eye Tyrant
monsters.description: A beholder of great size and age, floating in the air. His gaze seems to shred your soul and his spells crush your will. He is ancient, his history steeped in forgotten evils, his atrocities numerous and sickening.

monsters.name: Ungoliant, the Unlight
monsters.description: This enormous, hideous spirit of void is in the form of a spider of immense proportions. She is surrounded by a cloud of Unlight as she sucks in all living light into her bloated body, and breathes out the blackest of darkness. She is always ravenously hungry and would even eat herself to avoid starvation.

monsters.name: Aether hound
monsters.description: A shifting, swirling form. It seems to be all colours and sizes and shapes, though the dominant form is that of a huge dog. You feel very uncertain all of a sudden.

monsters.name: The Mouth of Sauron
monsters.description: The Mouth of Sauron is a mighty spell caster. So old that even he cannot remember his own name, his power and evil are undeniable. He believes unshakably that he is unbeatable and laughs as he weaves his awesome spells.

monsters.name: Master quylthulg
monsters.description: A giant seething mass of flesh, overwhelming you with monster after monster.

monsters.name: Qlzqqlzuup, the Emperor Quylthulg
monsters.description: A gigantic seething mass of flesh, Qlzqqlzuup changes colours in front of your eyes. Pulsating first one colour then the next, it knows only it must bring help to protect itself.

monsters.name: The Witch-King of Angmar
monsters.description: The Chief of the Ringwraiths. A fell being of devastating power. His spells are lethal and his combat blows crushingly hard. He moves at speed, and commands legions of evil to do his bidding. It is said that he is fated never to die by the hand of mortal man.

monsters.name: Pazuzu, Lord of Air
monsters.description: A winged humanoid demon from the Planes of Hell, Pazuzu grins inhumanely at you as he decides your fate.

monsters.name: Hellhound
monsters.description: A blazing hound from the depths of the pit, sleeping in a heat shimmer.

monsters.name: Cantoras, the Skeletal Lord
monsters.description: A legion of evil undead druj animating the skeleton of a once mighty sorcerer. His power is devastating and his speed unmatched in the underworld. Flee his wrath!

monsters.name: The Tarrasque
monsters.description: The Tarrasque is a massive reptile of legend, rumoured to be unkillable and immune to magic. Fear its anger, for its devastation is unmatched!

monsters.name: Lungorthin, the Balrog of White Fire
monsters.description: A massive form cloaked in flame. Lungorthin stares balefully at you with eyes that smoulder red. The dungeon floor where he stands is scorched by the heat of his body.

monsters.name: Draugluin, Sire of All Werewolves
monsters.description: Draugluin provides Sauron with a fearsome personal guard. He is an enormous wolf inhabited with a human spirit. He is chief of all his kind.

monsters.name: Vecna, the Emperor Lich
monsters.description: The greatest of all undead sorcerers, even the gods once feared him. This ancient shadow of death wilts every living thing it passes.

monsters.name: Huan, Wolfhound of the Valar
monsters.description: The wolfhound of the Valar, Huan has served many masters in his time, from Celegorm son of Feanor to Beren son of Barahir: but now he runs wild and acknowledges no master save himself, as he hunts alone for his nemesis - Carcharoth, the terrible wolf of IronHell.

monsters.name: Carcharoth, the Jaws of Thirst
monsters.description: The first guard of IronHell, Carcharoth, also known as 'The Red Maw', is the greatest wolf to ever walk the earth. He is highly intelligent and a deadly opponent in combat.

monsters.name: Gothmog, the High Captain of Balrogs
monsters.description: Gothmog is the Chief Balrog in Morgoth's personal guard. He is renowned for slaying Feanor and Fingon, two of the High Kings of the Noldor Elves, and has never been defeated in combat. With his whip of flame and awesome fiery breath he saved his master from Ungoliant's rage.

monsters.name: Sauron, the Sorcerer
monsters.description: He is Morgoth's most powerful servant. Mighty in spells and enchantments, he created the One Ring.

monsters.name: Morgoth, Lord of Darkness
monsters.description: He is the Master of the Pits of IronHell. His figure is like a black mountain crowned with lightning.

monsters.name: Silver mouse
monsters.description: It is about three feet long with large teeth. As the light of your lamp falls on it, it seems to grow stronger.

monsters.name: Rot jelly
monsters.description: It is a large pile of rotting flesh, whose touch spoils your food. The terrible smell it exudes is also very hard to get rid of...

monsters.name: Giant tan bat
monsters.description: A giant bat, the beating of whose wings produces a strangely unnerving noise.

monsters.name: Giant silver ant
monsters.description: A giant silver ant with a caustic bite.

monsters.name: Giant brown tick
monsters.description: It is moving slowly towards you.

monsters.name: Disenchanter bat
monsters.description: A giant bat which feeds on raw magical energy.

monsters.name: Shimmering mold
monsters.description: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor, glowing and crackling with sparks.

monsters.name: Wyvern
monsters.description: A fast-moving and deadly draconian animal. Beware its poisonous sting!

monsters.name: Chest mimic
monsters.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as a chest to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws. The first that most adventurers realise of the deception is when the seemingly invitingly open lid of the chest suddenly grows teeth and then slams shut on the adventurer's hand...

monsters.name: Demilich
monsters.description: A lich who is partially immaterial, on its way to a new, ethereal form.

monsters.name: Archlich
monsters.description: A lich who has reached its ultimate evolutionary stage: a completely immaterial state.

monsters.name: Crow
monsters.description: It is a hooded crow, gray except for the black wings and head.

monsters.name: Raven
monsters.description: Larger than a crow, and pitch black.

monsters.name: Crebain
monsters.description: A type of crow, specially bred by the forces of evil as spies; their rudimentary intelligence guided by an evil mind has tracked you down, and now they seek to alert other evil creatures to your presence.

monsters.name: Winged Horror
monsters.description: A terrifying sight: a winged creature greater than any bird you have ever seen, and with no feathers on its horrid black leathery wings. Descended from a creature of an older world perhaps, bred by Sauron to be a winged steed for his Ringwraiths.

monsters.name: Cave bear
monsters.description: A large bear appears to have made its home in this cave. It is hungry, and you are trespassing in its territory.

monsters.name: Grizzly bear
monsters.description: A huge, beastly bear, more savage than most of its kind.

monsters.name: Werebear
monsters.description: In the eyes of this bear, there glimmers the faintest light of intelligence. And then its form begins to change... The combination of animal cunning, human intelligence and the great physical strength of the bear makes for a dangerous enemy.

monsters.name: Beorn, the Shape-Changer
monsters.description: Beorn is only occasionally seen in human form these days, preferring to appear in the shape of a giant black bear: he also prefers the company of beasts to that of humans. He has never taken kindly to strangers, even in human form - and still less when in bear's shape, as he is now.

monsters.name: Barbazu
monsters.description: A foul, humanoid creature with a long tail, clawed hands and feet, and a disgusting, wiry, snaky beard. They are the elite shock troops of the hells, capable of a terrifying berserk fury.

monsters.name: Bile Demon
monsters.description: It's big. It's fat. It's red. It's ugly. It's got a severe attack of highly poisonous flatulence. And its insides are corrosive. All of which go together to make the single most repulsive sight - and smell - you have ever experienced.

monsters.name: Osyluth
monsters.description: It is a demon made almost entirely out of bones. It is humanoid, but with a large tail similar to that of a giant scorpion, and emits a foul smell of decay and rot. They are despised even in the hells.

monsters.name: Gelugon
monsters.description: This demon from the ice planes is a truly terrifying sight. It has an extremely large, insect-like body towering a full twelve feet tall, with great claws on its hands and pincers on its mouth, and its head bulges with great multi-faceted eyes. Its tail is covered with razor-sharp spikes.

monsters.name: Horned Reaper
monsters.description: A giant humanoid demon wielding a massive, heavy and sharp scythe. Feared by foes and friends alike when it flies into one of its berserk rages, the Horned Reaper will cut down anything in its path between it and you - even the minions it has just summoned.

monsters.name: Pit Fiend
monsters.description: Appearing as a giant, clawed and winged humanoid with a scaly red body and massive fangs dripping a foul green liquid, the Pit Fiend is a dreadful enemy from the lowest depths of the hells. They are often the commanders of vast demon armies.

monsters.name: Greater Balrog
monsters.description: Originally of the semi-divine Maiar, this evil spirit swore allegiance to Morgoth at the beginning of time and is now one of his most terrible demonic servants. With its flaming whip and sword it seeks to destroy you.

monsters.name: Baby bronze dragon
monsters.description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a dull bronze.

monsters.name: Baby gold dragon
monsters.description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale gold.

monsters.name: Great Swamp Wyrm
monsters.description: A truly enormous dragon with great powers. The foul gases issuing from the beast nearly make you vomit; and while you may try to hold your breath as you fight it, it sees no reason to do likewise.

monsters.name: Great Wyrm of Perplexity
monsters.description: A dragon of great size and power. Its polished bronze scales reflect the light in strange and confusing patterns, and you find it hard to keep your mind on the job of fighting for your life.

monsters.name: Great Bile Wyrm
monsters.description: A huge and very powerful dragon. Great steaming pools of acid drip from its form onto the ground. You shudder when you see the acid eating away the very stones of the dungeon - what could it do to you?

monsters.name: Great Wyrm of Thunder
monsters.description: A dragon of gigantic proportions, with destructive abilities to match. The sheer loudness of its roar leaves you stunned and unable to think clearly enough to defend yourself adequately.

monsters.name: Ranger
monsters.description: A warrior who is at one with nature. A master of both bow and sword, with minor spellcasting skills, and animals come to do his bidding.

monsters.name: Paladin
monsters.description: A warrior for a holy cause. Unfortunately, his god is not yours, and there is rivalry even between the various gods of Good, so he is your enemy.

monsters.name: Ranger Chieftain
monsters.description: A chieftain among the Rangers. His understanding of nature gives him powerful elemental spells to use against you, in addition to his skills as an archer and a warrior. Furthermore, he is a master of camouflage, so you will need magically enhanced seeing to spot him.

monsters.name: Berserker
monsters.description: Even the strongest of normal human warriors fears the Berserker - the one who can drive himself into such a terrible battle-frenzy that he can survive blows which should kill him, and still apparently feel no pain. He tramples weaker creatures underfoot in his eagerness to get to his real enemy, and his battle-cry strikes terror into his foes.

monsters.name: Cyclops
monsters.description: A gigantic ugly humanoid with but one eye and very thick skin.

monsters.name: Polyphemus, the Blind Cyclops
monsters.description: No ordinary cyclops, but the son of a sea-god: he wields the powers of elemental water as well as the considerable strength of a cyclops. His one eye was blinded long ago by the warrior Odysseus, but he has trained himself to hear so well that it nearly makes up for his disability.

monsters.name: Atlas, the Titan
monsters.description: The strongest of all the Titans. Legend has it that he used to hold the sky on his shoulders; and the mountain range that now does so is named after him.

monsters.name: Kronos, Lord of the Titans
monsters.description: The lord of the Titans, he has broken loose from his confinement in the nether hells to seek revenge on the world.

monsters.name: Evil eye
monsters.description: A huge disembodied eye. As you stare into the black nothingness of its pupil, you feel your will and vitality draining away, and are unable to do anything except approach it in horrified fascination.

monsters.name: Spectator
monsters.description: A lesser relative of the beholder: a globular body with a large toothy mouth, a large central eye, and four smaller eyes on stalks protruding from the top of its body.

monsters.name: Gauth
monsters.description: Another lesser relative of the beholder, this six-eyed creature feeds on magic.

monsters.name: Beholder hive-mother
monsters.description: A hive mother of the race of beholders, she can summon her brood to her aid whenever she wishes.

monsters.name: Neekerbreeker
monsters.description: Believed to be an evil relative of the cricket, this creature gets its name from its incessant squeaking, which can best be described as "neek-breek, neek-breek". The noise can drive people frantic, and worse still, can be heard for quite some distance, alerting other monsters to your presence.

monsters.name: Giant firefly
monsters.description: Clouds of these monsters light up the dungeon - so brightly that you can barely see through them.

monsters.name: Eol, the Dark Elf
monsters.description: A lord of the Teleri, Eol is a mighty metalsmith, the only one to ever forge weapons of meteorite iron. The mortal enemy of the Eldar, he is currently fleeing their wrath, following the murder of Princess Aredhel of Gondolin.

monsters.name: Maeglin, the Traitor of Gondolin
monsters.description: The son of Eol the Dark Elf, Maeglin is every bit as evil as his father and more. His greed for gold led him to betray the Hidden Kingdom of Gondolin to Morgoth's forces. He is a mighty warrior himself, and some of Morgoth's greatest servants answer to his call.

monsters.name: Elder vampire
monsters.description: A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others. It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.

monsters.name: Silent watcher
monsters.description: A figure carved from stone, with three vulture faces whose eyes glow with a malevolent light.

monsters.name: Nighthawk
monsters.description: Trained to hunt and kill without fear.

monsters.name: Ghoul
monsters.description: An emaciated undead creature that paralyzes with its touch, haunting old graveyards.

monsters.name: Ghast
monsters.description: A more powerful form of ghoul that paralysis with terrible force and drains constitution.

monsters.name: Greater Basilisk
monsters.description: An enormous serpent whose gaze can turn flesh to stone.

monsters.name: Aranea
monsters.description: An intelligent arachnid whose hairy legs weave spells in the air.

monsters.name: Elder aranea
monsters.description: A vast, bloated arachnid, master of its brood: among the more terrible of Ungoliant's descendants, this is a monster such as those who haunted the dread valley of Nan Dungortheb long ago.

monsters.name: Kobold Shaman
monsters.description: A kobold who has stolen a handful of crude spells and wields them recklessly.

monsters.name: Bat of Gorgoroth
monsters.description: Fed with horrid meats and grown to enormous size, this slavering creature seeks livelier prey.

monsters.name: Doombat
monsters.description: It is a fast moving creature of chaos, a gigantic black bat surrounded by flickering bright red flames.

monsters.name: Wolf chieftain
monsters.description: A great wolf-chieftain whose pack is in the service of the Dark Lord, and whose howls strike fear into even the boldest heart.

monsters.name: Bone golem
monsters.description: A skeletal form, black as night, constructed from the bones of its previous victims.

monsters.name: Bronze golem
monsters.description: A gigantic four-armed animated bronze statue of demonic shape, glowing with great heat.

monsters.name: Ogre chieftain
monsters.description: This ogre is leader of his tribe. He sneers at you as he advances towards you, wielding a huge club and pushing his own followers rudely aside.

monsters.name: Ar-Pharazon the Golden
monsters.description: Last and proudest king of ancient Numenor. Corrupted by power and avarice, he fell victim to Sauron's wiles, tried to fight the Valar themselves, and condemned Numenor to oblivion.

monsters.name: Troll chieftain
monsters.description: This troll's great strength and size have won it the place of chieftain of its tribe. It fears nothing.

monsters.name: Shardstorm
monsters.description: A howling blast of razor-sharp mountain fragments, kept intact by perilous magics.

monsters.name: Storm of Unmagic
monsters.description: Howling through the disintegrating dungeon, this whirlpool of Unmagic rips the enchantments from everything it touches.

monsters.name: Greater mummy
monsters.description: Once a powerful ruler, now an even more powerful undead menace.

monsters.name: Multi-hued hound
monsters.description: Shimmering in rainbow hues, this hound is beautiful and deadly.
